title: The ship sails. The link expires.
scenario: While ashore, a WhatsApp message claiming to be your excursion operator says the return pickup point changed. It asks for a €25 “port access reissue” within ten minutes or your seat will be released.

answers.A: Ask another person in your booked group whether they received the same change and compare details.
answers.B: Pay the small fee so your seat stays protected, then ask for a refund onboard if it was unnecessary.
answers.C: Use the excursion voucher or cruise-line app to contact the operator through the number or channel you already had.

explanation: Being far from the ship magnifies urgency. A real operator change should survive an independent callback through the original booking channel.
proTip: When missing the ship is the fear, verify through the booking you already own.
